## Page: Family Home with Large Garden, Chiang Mai
<p>A well-maintained family home on over 1 rai of land in a secure moo baan. Open-plan kitchen and living area, covered carport for 3 cars, mature garden with fruit trees. Walking distance to two international schools.</p>

## Page: Beachfront Studio at Hua Hin
<p>Ground-floor studio with direct beach access, ideal for short-term rental or a weekend retreat. Managed building with reception, pool, restaurant on-site. Consistent occupancy year-round.</p>

## Page: Development Land, East Pattaya (2 Rai)
<p>Prime development land on the eastern corridor of Pattaya, suitable for a small villa project (6–8 units) or a single luxury estate. Chanote title, electricity and water on-site. No flood history.</p>

<p>Set on a hillside overlooking the Andaman Sea, this contemporary villa blends indoor-outdoor living with lush tropical gardens. The open-plan living area flows onto the pool deck. Chanote title, fully landscaped.</p>
